profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Defense & Biotech Software | C#/.NET Architect | Distributed Systems | Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience delivering mission-critical software across the defense, biotechnology, and enterprise SaaS industries. I lead complex technical initiatives from architecture through delivery, partnering closely with clients, product owners, and engineering teams to build scalable, high-impact solutions.

My experience spans technical leadership, product ownership, system architecture, and mentoring distributed engineering teams. I’ve established engineering standards, developed reusable platforms, and driven process improvements that accelerated software delivery by more than 20% while improving quality and developer productivity.

I specialize in cloud-native application development, distributed systems, and enterprise architecture using C#, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and Java. My technical expertise includes RESTful APIs, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and much more. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges while enabling teams to deliver reliable, scalable software.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served both as Principal Engineer and Team Lead driving DoD mission development, modeling & simulation (M&S) capabilities and technical strategy.
- Help architect distributed, event-driven microservices deployed on Kubernetes/Linux, leveraging Python (FastAPI), Go, TypeScript (React), Java, C#, Kafka, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Helm.
- Led cross-functional engineering teams through architecture, technical execution, and Agile delivery across two-week sprint cycles.
- Drove system architecture, technical roadmaps, requirements decomposition, and mission-focused capability development with government and industry stakeholders.
- Mentored engineering teams and external partners while leading architecture reviews, technical tradeoffs, integration strategy, and program-level technical direction.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Linux · TypeScript · Kubernetes · Cross-functional Team Leadership

positions.title: Technical Solutions Lead
positions.description:
- Created reusable C#, .NET SaaS application templates, adopted company-wide, to standardize architecture and speed up development across multiple product lines.
- Organized and led SaaS architecture workshops that reduced IRT software development time by 20%+, through knowledge sharing and process alignment.
- Served as SME for three high-impact product lines, shaping architecture, feature planning, and strategic direction for core clinical trial platforms.
- Mentored 10+ development teams across the U.S. and Romania, coaching engineers, leading architectural discussions, and resolving technical blockers.
- Work with senior architecture team to help drive development and training on new architectural patterns like Low-code/No-Code development and LLM-based retrieval augmented generation (RAG) software

positions.title: Senior Software Developer, Team Lead
positions.description:
- Designed and developed backend applications using C#, .NET Core, MVC, Entity Framework, and SQL Server for enterprise IRT (Interactive Response Technology) systems.
- Conducted code reviews and authored Confluence best practice guides on patterns, architecture, and team workflows.
- Built secure, scalable RESTful APIs with Swagger documentation, OAuth2-based authentication, and consistent versioning standards.
- Used Docker, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps to streamline builds, deployments, and infrastructure provisioning.
- Supported team resourcing and efficiency, helping balance workload, clarify ownership, and resolve bottlenecks in delivery processes.
- Led projects using both Agile and Waterfall delivery models, depending on business and regulatory requirements.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
- Work as part of the Benefits Outsourcing team to design and develop pension administration systems for large market technology clients
- Act as technical lead on new implementations and ongoing client teams with budgets ranging up to $6m
- Utilize a variety of modern tools and languages such as C#, C++, ASP.NET MVC, .NET 4.7+ Frameworks, MS SQL Server, JavaScript, Azure DevOps, SOAP/ RESTful APIs, etc.
- Deliver timely unit tested high quality systems
- Take part in CI/CD development pipeline and Agile design patterns (Scrum) to ensure projects are delivered on time and without error
- Take part in conducting code reviews
- Provide key support towards internal initiatives to ensure technology stays up to date
- Help budget, delegate, and allocate resources needed to complete projects efficiently and on time
- Known as SME in most parts of WTWs technical stack.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Test pre-production networking hardware and software
- Work with a variety of networking technologies such as IPv6, PoE, Network Security, and Wireless
- Set-up and perform complex tests involving Web-UI, Interoperability, and Security
- Work with a small team of testers in order to efficiently finish projects

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Took part in developing both front and back end features on company website
- Used multiple languages such as C#, VB, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL
- Gained knowledge of many features such as ASP.net MVC4, jQuery, SVN
- Worked with large team of programmers in professional environment
- Dealt with strict deadlines and tight schedule
